decisions.label: Climbers: dashes a stack
decisions.note: Extra dash charges each Climbers-and-fliers stack gives her (Ed, 2026-11-03: first values, "to be set in play").

decisions.label: Darters: speed a stack
decisions.note: Her speed, plus this share, each Darters stack (Ed: "Maybe 10%").

decisions.label: Stalkers: 💌 speed a stack
decisions.note: Her 💌s' speed, plus this share, each Stalkers stack (Ed, 2026-11-03: first values, "to be set in play").

decisions.label: Stalkers: 💌 range a stack
decisions.note: Her 💌s' range, plus this share, each Stalkers stack (Ed, 2026-11-03: first values, "to be set in play").

decisions.label: Heavies: ways a stack
decisions.note: More ways her shots go round her each Heavies stack, her fire rate times the ways (1: a second shot opposite between each).

decisions.label: Pack hunters: fire rate a stack
decisions.note: Her fire rate, plus this share, each Pack hunters stack (Ed: "Maybe 10%").

decisions.label: Pack hunters: spread a stack
decisions.note: Degrees more spread on her shots each Pack hunters stack (Ed, 2026-11-03: first values, "to be set in play").

decisions.label: Shells: chain hops a stack
decisions.note: Extra chain hops on her 💌s each Shells-diggers-and-swimmers stack, on top of the chaining bag's.

decisions.label: Legend stacks
decisions.note: Stacks a leashed legend gives its group (Ed: "the equivalent of 3x of that animal types' buff").

decisions.label: Pips per adult
decisions.note: Berry pips an adult holds at most (Ed's note: 5).

decisions.label: Pip life (s)
decisions.note: Seconds each berry pip lasts, draining one at a time while it follows her (Ed's note: 2 minutes).
